purpose: Complete a representative, public, source-replayable quality/cost observation using unchanged engine defaults. No application quality certification or new numeric floor is requested.

implementation.commit_field_reason: Compiled in a clean source snapshot without an invented Git commit; exact source/overlay and binary hashes bind the implementation.

mode_strategies.text_bm25: FTS5 default tokenizer; candidate LIMIT before Rust metadata filtering; pure text does not pass fusion.
mode_strategies.vector_exact: Metadata eligibility before exact vec_distance_cosine scoring; separate vector/fusion windows.
mode_strategies.hybrid: FTS candidate truncation before metadata filtering, exact filtered vector branch, existing window-only weighted fusion; no CofferDB complete-U supplemental scoring.
mode_strategies.disclosure: The baseline has its own scoring/filter/candidate strategy and includes CLI startup. Identical top_k is not identical recall work or matched latency boundaries.

common_config.candidate_policy: max(preset default,top_k); all tasks use k10 so effective defaults remain500/200/50

dataset_scope.groups: 3 materials by4 query types,4 tasks each; materials have equal source/task counts but unequal chunk counts.
dataset_scope.source_selection: Pinned Rust std::fs eight APIs, eight captured official SQLite documentation sections, first eight lexicographically ordered eligible2020 Rust lang-team design-meeting notes chosen before task authoring.
dataset_scope.task_origin: Source-derived English authored information needs, not observed human query logs or universal population coverage.
dataset_scope.judgment_origin: One task-author annotation plus one independent exhaustive annotation,20 uncertain/disagreeing pairs adjudicated and twice reviewed before retrieval. AI-assisted; not human relevance certification.
dataset_scope.vector_preparation: 99passages+48queries offline E5 ONNX CPU mean pooling/L2 f32, query:/passage: prefixes, dimension384, no truncation; full provenance and vectors supplied.
dataset_scope.omitted_images: T05 formula PNGs and T08 diagram GIF not bundled; tasks/labels cannot depend on them.

environment.storage: Local temporary workspace on the host filesystem; physical I/O and SSD/controller cache are not instrumented.

execution_method.processes: Sequential separate fresh database for each of six profile/round runs; no concurrent evaluation runs; each built-in query is sequential. Shared host scheduling/background load is disclosed.
execution_method.warmup_reason: Reproduce explicit first-pass reopened-handle and repeated-handle groups. No warmups are discarded: the complete first pass is measured and the complete repeat is measured. This does not claim steady-state or OS-cold timing.
execution_method.cache_states: Built-in cold=reopened database handle, warm=repeated query group; no OS-page-cache eviction. Different SQLite per-query subprocess semantics disclosed.
execution_method.order: text_bm25,vector_exact,hybrid; within each mode cold then warm; exact query order; profile order reverses in external round2.

timeouts.rule: 120s observed/reported query deadline applies only to CofferDB journal events. SQLite has no separately instrumented per-query deadline; the entire profile including baseline has7200s. External polling is not a strict engine deadline. Abort on first failure; retain all planned rows, observed terminal states and explicitly unknown baseline progress.

execution_method.resources: Whole timed process maxRSS and real/user/system from native /usr/bin/time -l plus built-in SELF peak and per-query search-cost ledgers. Record process/descendant scope, no sum of RSS peaks and no per-query CPU or physical I/O claim.
execution_method.environment_requirement: Native local execution must permit the read-only hardware/time probes; any probe/measurement failure is retained and reported, not turned into a database success.

failure_accounting.cofferdb: Per-sample plan and journal projection; unstarted rows include actual abort/timeout reason. Absent/nonunique/malformed journal leaves unprovable progress unknown, never assumed success.
failure_accounting.sqlite: Full1728plan. A complete result with all frozen assertions passed yields individual completed rows and latency. A launched profile without a verified complete baseline result yields288unknown_not_observed rows and original failure/log hashes. Future profiles never launched are not_run with the actual abort reason. No unknown record counts as evaluation completeness.
failure_accounting.cleanup: After the owned leader exits or supervisor fails, any surviving owned process group is signaled SIGKILL and checked for absence for up to2s. Leftover group and cleanup actions remain errors even when cleanup succeeds. No unrelated process group is targeted.

execution_method.python_runtime: Assertions must be enabled. The runner explicitly rejects optimized Python before any input check or execution; -O/-OO/PYTHONOPTIMIZE are forbidden.

metric_method.recall: Number of judged-positive IDs in firstk unique returned ranks divided by all judged-positive eligible IDs for that query; macro over48 tasks or4task group.
metric_method.mrr: Reciprocal of first judged-positive rank up to10, else0; macro.
metric_method.labels: Full eligible binary judgments; every ineligible result is a contract/error observation, not a silently excluded sample; no unjudged eligible pairs.
metric_method.no_positive_queries: Reject malformed preparation before retrieval; every frozen query has at least one positive.
metric_method.numeric: Exact Fraction arithmetic for relevance aggregate and signed deltas; compare built-in metrics within1e-12. Independently recomputed source-reference scores checked by existing runner with relative1e-12 tolerance. Cross-engine scores not comparable.
metric_method.latency: Nearest rank ceil(p*n)-1 over unrounded successful raw query durations;48samples/group/round; pool96samples only sameprofile/mode/cache/engine across2rounds. Never average P95s. Incomplete groups diagnostic only; failure/timeout counts and complete plan retained.
metric_method.comparisons: All3presets/default hybrid and both single branches, SQLite, every12cell group and negative delta disclosed. No floor or superiority gate.
metric_method.release_boundary: Execution completeness, engine-context/source-reference/cost assertions, scheme observations and overall release acceptance are separate. Scheme certification not requested.

historical_evidence: Original failed verdicts, source identities and all exploratory positive/negative observations retained in a separately derived archive; no old results relabeled as current presets or new execution.
limitations: Small source-derived corpus,AI relevance judgments and48tasks cannot establish universal quality or statistical population generality.
New protocol exists to supply shareable representative evidence, not to tune past a withdrawn target; no default weight/model/algorithm change.
This single Mac quality matrix does not repeat or replace existing Linux/MSRV/large-file/CI evidence.
Quality latency is not a100k-scale benchmark; older scale/resource evidence needs separate source applicability and publication review.
SQLite startup/scoring/tokenization differs; no causal speed ranking, comparable raw scores or equal recall-work claim.
Input vectors are external artifacts; engine guarantees its calculations, not semantics.
Current worktree contains reviewed test/document overlays; archive/binary hashes rather than base Git commit alone identify the evaluated source.
Public publication remains separate from draft preparation and protocol approval.

revision.reason: Independent review: fail closed before any action when Python optimization would erase assertion-based approval/hash/statistical checks. Other v3 methods, inputs and defaults unchanged.
